proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ F M τ hτ
  refine ⟨fun h => h.stoppedProcess hτ, fun h => ?_⟩
  have h1 := h.submartingale.stoppedProcess hτ
  have h2 := h.neg.submartingale.stoppedProcess hτ
  refine MeasureTheory.martingale_iff.mpr ⟨?_, h1⟩
  have e : MeasureTheory.stoppedProcess (-M) τ = -MeasureTheory.stoppedProcess M τ := by
    funext n ω; simp [MeasureTheory.stoppedProcess]
  rw [e] at h2
  have := h2.neg
  simpa using this
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] (F : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0) (M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (τ : Ω → WithTop ℕ), MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime F τ → (MeasureTheory.Submartingale M F P → MeasureTheory.Submartingale (MeasureTheory.stoppedProcess M τ) F P) ∧ (MeasureTheory.Martingale M F P → MeasureTheory.Martingale (MeasureTheory.stoppedProcess M τ) F P)
